decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a low-cost accessory that complements the flooring system, and with industry growth and slack there is no shortfall pressing enough to trigger search.
After the maintenance oil line was dropped, the care product for oiled floors becomes the main care offer for oiled parquet, which strengthens its role in customer relationships.
The moisture-protection underlay is an expected system accessory for installers, and there is no evidence that it falls short of aspirations.
The high-density foam may overlap with the other underlay, but organisational slack lets the firm carry it while its results remain uncertain.
The oak parquet line is core to the firm's business in a growing market, so withdrawing it is very unlikely.
